blocking: On desktop (index-desktop-4.jpg), the fixed header covers the top half of the cream wordmark inside the brown 'Reimagined Heritage' poster-frame CTA, and its cream background breaks the continuity of the 2px cream inset border.

fixes.what: Increase `.cta--poster` top padding to `clamp(112px, 15vh, 144px)` and set `.cta--poster::before { top: 24px }` with enough vertical clearance so the fixed 96px header never collides with `.cta__wordmark` or cuts off the top of the 2px inset poster border when scrolled into view.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-4.jpg, the fixed header slices right through `cta__wordmark` ('ANAR EVENTS' is cut in half) and hides the top edge of the cream poster frame.

fixes.what: Consider adjusting `--red` from `#9E1B32` to match the `#D10C0C` red used inside `logo-red.svg` (or vice-versa).
fixes.why: The brand rubric specifies red `#D10C0C` (which is baked into the SVG wordmark), whereas CSS rules, eyebrows, and buttons use `#9E1B32` burgundy, creating a subtle two-red mismatch next to the header logo.

fixes.what: Add `text-align: right` to `.accordion__body .fa` or keep it aligned with the Persian header convention used across the rest of the site.
